title: Constellation Builder
summary: Trace fourteen constellations in a midnight atlas. Reveal a gold engraving with the final star and discover how Andromeda, Perseus and Cetus share a myth.
summaryZhTW: 在午夜星圖上連起十四個星座。點亮最後一顆星，揭開金色版畫，讀仙女座、英仙座與鯨魚座共同的神話。
coverAlt: Gold engraving of Pegasus soaring across an indigo star chart beside the title Constellation Builder.
controls: Click or tap stars in any order, or use Tab and Enter or Space. Switch charts with the atlas selector and toggle the trace guide for a hint.
